Name: d-for
Description: The d-for expression that wil be used

Name: d-if
Description: The conditional that will be used to check if we will apply the expressions to the item in d-for. The slot must be present but can be left empty, for example FilterData(item in data,,dataFiltered), to keep every item

Name: DataKey
Description: The identification of a storage that filtered data will be stored

Name: Notify
Description: You can choose if you want no notify the change to the observer
